meta.title: AI Gijinka · Shared World, Individual Personas
meta.description:
TWO LAYERS: world contains shared lore, public character identities and relationships; persona contains only the current character's identity and personal memories. Includes 11 documented families. Versions of a family share a role; undocumented models remain unassigned.

CONVERSATIONAL EDITS: Ask the AI to save a shared relationship or change the current persona. persona_edit uses scope=world or persona. Successful writes update the affected cache automatically for the next request, without asking the user to refresh or restart DSH. A verbal promise is not a saved change.

LOADED AI INSTRUCTIONS: instructions/README.md is read by the plugin and explicitly included in its global prompt section. After edits made with other file tools, the AI should call one targeted reload. Plugin-owned edits already update the cache and need no second reload. No directory scanning on warm requests, file watchers, timers, session clearing or DSH restarts. Independent DSH instances do not synchronize in the background.

CUSTOMIZATION: Ask persona_manage to create a character, bind models or unbind them. These writes update the binding cache automatically; only externally edited indexes need action=reload. Custom character names become public, but private files are not copied into world lore. API providers and credentials still belong in DSH settings. /persona help explains the flow; /persona world shows shared lore. Disabling allowAgentWrite removes the conversational write tools.
